_source: EN 14592:2022 (SN EN 14592:2022, SIA 265.177; it replaces SN EN 14592+A1:2012), Anhang G, G.4 «Stabdübel» and Tabelle G.9 «Spezifikationen von Werkstoff und Festigkeit für Stabdübel», read in the reference libraryEN-14592-2022-DE.pdf, PDF p. 81 (12.10.2026, spec 2026-10-12-audit-issues-47-48-49, REQ-007). SIA 265:2021 6.2.1.1 names the product standard for a Stabdübel.
_note: Tabelle G.9 asks of a dowel's bar a **minimum yield stress** of 235 N/mm² (EN 10025-2, EN 10277; stainless steel to EN 10088-1) and an elongation at maximum force of 8 %, and gives **no tensile strength**. SIA 265 6.1.4.4 equation (87) reads f_u,k: Woodcore takes it from the bar's steel grade, SIA 263:2013 Tabelle 1 (calc/norms/sia263-2013-tab01-baustaehle.json, thin band, a dowel being at most 30 mm), a grade offered only where its f_y meets G.9's minimum. `default_steel` is the grade a new Stabdübel starts with -- S355, f_u = 510 N/mm², the value every Stabdübel was calculated with before 12.10.2026, credited until then to SN EN 14592+A1:2012 (D-20). The value stays writable: a fastener declaring a strength of its own types it.
